summary: First testing run for LEAFVA MVP. Comprehensive backend (22 pytest tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing. ALL backend endpoints work as specified. All public/admin pages, navigation, login, AI chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5), AI email composer, settings (Resend key save), and the full chat intake -> ticket auto-creation flow are verified working. Resend is correctly returning status='mocked' as intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Chat dock toggle button (bottom-right, z-50) sits in the exact same screen corner as the 'Made with Emergent' floating badge. Playwright's normal click() is intercepted; works via JS click or force=True. Functionally OK but the two floating elements visually overlap on standard desktop viewports.

issues: HTML <title> is the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' for every route (/, /services, /about, /contact, /assistant, /legal/*, /admin/*). No per-page SEO titles set. Not a blocker for MVP, but worth fixing in /app/frontend/public/index.html or via react-helmet for SEO.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Reposition ChatDock toggle a bit higher or to the left so it doesn't visually collide with the 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right.
(Optional) Add per-route <title> tags (react-helmet-async or simple useEffect setting document.title) so pages don't all read 'Emergent | Fullstack App'.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is well-structured: routes split into routes_chat / routes_business / auth, models in Pydantic, Mongo via UUID ids (no _id leakage observed).
ai_chat.py correctly strips the [INTAKE_COMPLETE: {...}] marker from user-visible reply and parses the JSON server-side -- verified via test (ticket auto-created within 3 turns).
email_service.py 'mocked' status correctly bypasses Resend SDK when key empty, and logs entry to /api/email/logs -- verified.
Invoice tax math correct (subtotal 250, tax 13% = 32.5, total 282.5) and payment auto-marks invoice 'paid' when amount >= total -- verified.
/api/settings/public correctly excludes resend_api_key and other secrets -- verified.
Frontend uses data-testid on all critical elements; api.js attaches Bearer token; /admin redirect to /admin/login works when no token.
seed_data_creation: Chat intake test created one Ticket (John Doe, system administration, emergency). Invoice + payment test created 1 invoice (marked paid). All other CRUD tests cleaned up after themselves. Settings reverted to defaults (resend_api_key empty, company_name=LEAFVA).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Chat flow may need 2-4 turns to trigger [INTAKE_COMPLETE]; test uses 4 turns with explicit 'please file the ticket'. Resend is intentionally unconfigured (returns 'mocked') — DO NOT flag this as a bug.
